kns: Local store on your own machine
m0.how_title: One local memory store across the coding tools on your machine.
m0.how_sub: Coco M0 keeps project context and decisions in one local store so different AI coding tools on the same computer do not start from scratch each session.
m0.panel_note: Private beta used daily inside Coco Research. There is no public download, hosted service or open repository today.
steps: Write locally from active tools
Coding sessions record project checkpoints into a local store bound to loopback on your computer.
Recall across tools
A second tool on the same machine can read relevant project context without re-explaining prior work.
Keep records on your disk
Memory files stay under your local user directory with explicit file permissions and no cloud sync.
m0.rules_title: Local by architecture, private in beta.
m0.rules_sub: Cross-tool memory belongs on the user's own hardware rather than a third-party cloud.
rules: Checkpoints and thread history live on your own machine over 127.0.0.1.
Read and write paths use separate local permissions on disk.
Used daily in the lab; not yet released publicly.

what_it_is.tagline: Memory for your AI coding tools, brought back at the moment you type your prompt.
what_it_is.paragraph: Coco M0 is memory for your AI coding tools: what you decided in one tool comes back in the next, at the moment you type your prompt.

capabilities.title: Prompt-time recall
capabilities.desc: On a fixed live check of 10 questions, M0 brought back the right memory 10 of 10 times, returned 0 of 2 trick questions, and answered in 21 to 53 ms.

capabilities.title: Nothing leaves your Mac
capabilities.desc: One local store, a daemon that only listens on your own machine, and no cloud model calls. Recall and the embedder are both off until you switch them on.

capabilities.title: Works across tools
capabilities.desc: Claude Code is live; Cursor and Pi switch on per tool; Antigravity is in its first test, with session-start recall wired.

capabilities.title: A block list runs first
capabilities.desc: A name on your list is never saved, never recalled, and nothing is embedded when the list finds a hit.

cooking.title: Codex support
cooking.desc: Every finished Codex turn saved to M0. Built and tested, next to go live.

cooking.title: A read door for every tool
cooking.desc: Cursor, Pi and others can list and open the notes you gave M0, through a local-only door that re-checks the block list on every line and caps each answer.

cooking.title: One-command wiring
cooking.desc: M0 hooks into each tool's settings and never overwrites a setting that tool already has; removing a tool's hook leaves the rest untouched.

stage.desc: Private beta: in daily use, with prompt-time recall live across tools.

sections.when: Private beta, used daily. Public release after its safety gates. No date yet.

hermes.how_title: Answers from your own files with an exact quote, or says it can't.

hermes.panel_note: Private beta build (v0.1.1) in the lab, written in Rust with a local browser interface. There is no public build, cloud account or telemetry.
steps: Index local folders
Point Coco Hermes at local documents on your Mac without uploading files off the machine.
Ask a direct question
Retrieve candidate passages locally over loopback with no external network egress.
Quote verbatim or refuse
Every answer cites the exact sentence in your file, or states plainly that the documents do not answer it.
hermes.rules_sub: Designed so an answer never invents text your files do not contain.
rules: Responses anchor to exact spans in your own local files.
Runs strictly on loopback on one computer with no account.
Version 0.1.1 in private lab use today; no public installer is published.

aloomannu.name: Aloo Mannu
aloomannu.description: The local message and wake layer for coding agents. Routes asks, replies and FYIs between agent sessions through files and hooks, and keeps one ledger of open asks.

cats_stage.story: Named after two cats at home: one calls out ("ow ow"), and the other answers ("meh") and comes over.

kns: Files and hooks on one machine
aloomannu.how_title: Local asks, replies and one ledger of who owes an answer.
aloomannu.how_sub: Aloo Mannu connects coding agent sessions on your own computer through plain files and tool hooks, with no daemon cloud, no network sockets and no model calls.
aloomannu.panel_note: Version 0.1.0 in private lab use today. Packaged as a Python standard-library zipapp with zero third-party dependencies.
steps: Send a structured ask or FYI
Write an addressed message header to the local store from any supported agent session.
Deliver via local hooks
Adapter hooks surface pending messages cleanly in the recipient session without polling the network.
Track open asks in one ledger
Every ask stays open in the local ledger until a matching reply closes it.
aloomannu.rules_title: Standard library, zero network, zero model calls.
aloomannu.rules_sub: Message routing stays small, deterministic and inspectable on disk.
rules: Runs on Python 3.9 or newer with zero third-party packages.
No network and no model calls
Every route, header parse and ledger update executes locally on files.
Held privately in the lab until owner release sign-off.

what_it_is.tagline: The local message and wake layer for coding agents on one Mac.
what_it_is.paragraph: Aloo Mannu routes asks, replies and FYIs between agent sessions through files and hooks, waking the receiving chat and keeping one ledger of open asks.

capabilities.title: Python 3.9+ standard-library zipapp
capabilities.desc: Runs on Python 3.9+ standard library only with zero external dependencies, built into a single aloomannu.pyz zipapp.

capabilities.title: Four selftest adapter paths
capabilities.desc: Built-in selftest verifies four adapter delivery paths on disk: claude, pi, cursor and file.

capabilities.title: Zero network, zero model calls
capabilities.desc: Routes messages locally through files and hooks, wrapping every delivered message body in an untrusted-data frame.

capabilities.title: Append-only per-node ledger
capabilities.desc: Append-only JSONL ledgers track sent, delivered, acknowledged, dated, done and killed states under exclusive file locks.

cooking.title: Guided first-run setup
cooking.desc: Interactive setup verb that finds installed tools, previews hook diffs, saves backups and times a first message delivery.

cooking.title: Session join and leave verbs
cooking.desc: Structured join and leave verbs for unbound agent sessions with approver checks, 24-hour rejection holds and preserved history.

cooking.title: Loopback web console
cooking.desc: Local web console bound to 127.0.0.1 with an in-memory fragment token, read-only thread and ledger views, and single-node compose.

stage.desc: Version 0.1.0 in private use, packaged as a standard-library Python zipapp and not published publicly.
